effect.after: The inlaid box on the desk hangs open, empty.
effect.message: You lift the lid of the inlaid box on the broad desk. A folded cream card sits inside.
You step up to the standing cards on the desk.
You bend over the desk by the box. One card reads: "Study 2".

effect.after: The wooden back door hangs unlocked behind you.
effect.message: You key the code into the plate on the locked wooden back door. The bolt clicks and you slip out.

intro: You are standing in the book-lined study with the marble fireplace and broad desk. Your way out is the locked wooden back door by the bookcase.

items.description: A small cream card, creased from the box.
items.name: Folded note
items.text: The brass code lock on the locked wooden back door by the fireplace takes two digits: the first is how many small display cards stand on the desk, the second is the number after Study on the cards.
